_comment: Editable factors for the FR 2052a liquidity metrics engine. All factors are DOCUMENTED APPROXIMATIONS of Regulation WW (LCR/NSFR) treatment applied to FR 2052a fields; they are not exact regulatory calculations. Edit values here to tune the engine without code changes. See ANALYTICS_NOTES.md.

hqla._comment: HQLA-eligibility and haircut by collateral-class prefix. FR 2052a asset-category codes ending in -Q denote HQLA-eligible collateral. Haircut is applied to MarketValue to approximate the stressed HQLA contribution (Level 1 ~0%, Level 2A 15%, Level 2B 50%).

outflow_runoff._comment: Stressed 30-day runoff rates approximating LCR outflow factors, applied to MaturityAmount. Deposits keyed by counterparty/insured; wholesale and secured by product group. Values are illustrative approximations.

secured_by_collateral_level._comment: Secured funding (repo etc.) runoff by collateral quality of the pledged asset.

inflow_rate._comment: Stressed 30-day inflow recognition rates approximating LCR inflow factors, applied to MaturityAmount of maturing inflows. Capped at 75% of outflows per LCR.

nsfr._comment: Approximate Available Stable Funding (ASF) and Required Stable Funding (RSF) factors for a simplified NSFR estimate. Highly simplified.

buckets._comment: Maturity buckets considered 'short-term' (<= 30 days) for rollover / STWF measures. Matched against the MaturityBucket enumeration.

analytics._comment: Thresholds for trend and statistical anomaly detection. All explainable/statistical; no ML.
